entries.e531f50c63158cf3: A manufacturer of copper and copper alloy products headquartered in Sakai, Osaka Prefecture, it is a consolidated subsidiary of CK Sanetsu Co., Ltd. It does not prepare consolidated financial statements, and its business is a single segment, the copper and copper alloy products business. It produces brass rods and other products at its headquarters factory in Sakai, and places its logistics warehouse and other facilities at Osaka Kodo Company in Higashinari Ward, Osaka City. The number of employees for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was 92.
